title: Knux
extract:
The Knux are large Archmelee gauntlets based on Tyl Regor's fist weapons.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Archmelee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Above average damage × attack speed (502.85)
High attack range (142.50 m)
Very high status chance (30.00%)
Above average total damage (445)
High crit multiplier (2.00x)
Disadvantages over other Archmelee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Low crit chance (13.00%)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The Knux's blueprint can be researched from the Chem Lab in the dojo.

Tips
Blocking with a melee will grant knockdown protection against obstacles, allowing for smoother flight. Alternatively, performing a slide/dash attack will allow passage through obstacles without slowing down.

Trivia
The Knux were first revealed in Devstream 53. At that time, the player would wield one Knux like a club with its palm open, although it is possible that this was just a placeholder animation.
Pressing the block button once will make the Knux spin its fists.
